description: Bid to fill an open request at your price and date.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria for your delivery (default: the request’s own, when it states them).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

by.description: Delivery date YYYY-MM-DD (default: the request’s date).

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

price.description: Your price per unit (in the request’s currency, default XRP).

quantity.description: Units you supply (default: all still needed).

name: market_bid
